net.guizhanss.gcereborn.core.services

Class LocalizationService

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.guizhanss.gcereborn.libs.guizhanlib.localization.Localization
      • net.guizhanss.gcereborn.libs.guizhanlib.localization.MinecraftLocalization
        • net.guizhanss.gcereborn.core.services.LocalizationService

  • public final class LocalizationService
extends MinecraftLocalization
    Localization + item-lookup service.

    This extends GuizhanLib's MinecraftLocalization directly (a plain YAML-file localization helper, no Slimefun coupling) rather than its SlimefunLocalization subclass: that subclass's getItem/getItemGroupItem/getRecipeType methods return the pre-fork package's SlimefunItemStack - a type this fork's renamed API no longer has - so invoking them would throw NoClassDefFoundError. The same lookup behaviour (key/id -> name + lore -> item) is reimplemented here against the fork's own SlimefunItemStack / RecipeType.
